description:
Outcome: Owner inspects plain-language large-text journeys, from brief.md: Constraints
Scope: Navigable synthetic prototype for application/preferences, allocation and waitlist status, reporting, coordinator allocation/map/problems; keyboard/focus, labels and reflow. Excludes: Production writes
Acceptance: All key screens have empty/loading/error states; usable narrow phone viewport and zoom; readable type and plain language
Behaviour: Accessible feedback and recovery; no color-only meaning
Verification: Keyboard, zoom and mobile walkthrough. Prerequisites: T-001. Assumptions: Visual style delegated
title: Phone journey prototype
